description:
Size the yearly market for a business category in a place in Spain, in euros, with a range.

    Market = households × INE household spending on the category × an income adjustment.
    Supply = competing businesses, calibrated against INE's company directory. Returns market
    per business and an opportunity score: market per business against the region (1.0 = same as
    the region), not a forecast of openings. Every assumption is listed. Assumptions can be overridden to test scenarios. Use for "how big
    is the market for X in Y" and "is Y under-served for X".

capture_share.description: Share of the market one business could win (0-1), to estimate obtainable revenue.
capture_share.title: Capture Share

category.description: Business category: restaurant, cafe, bar, fast_food, bakery, butcher, greengrocer, supermarket, pharmacy, optician, dentist, physiotherapy, hairdresser, beauty_salon, veterinary, gym, childcare, private_school, clothes, home. Plain words work too ('gyms', 'peluquerías').
category.title: Category

competitors.description: Override the estimated number of competing businesses.
competitors.title: Competitors

place.description: Place name or INE code: municipality ('Valladolid' or '47186'), province ('41'; a bare name like 'Sevilla' means the city), autonomous community ('Cataluña' or 'CA09'), district ('4718603') or census tract ('4718603012'). 'Name, Province' picks between same-named towns.
place.title: Place

spend_per_household.description: Override INE's yearly spend per household on the category, in euros.
spend_per_household.title: Spend Per Household

name: market_size

mapping_completeness.description: Mapped pharmacies and bars per resident vs the region; under 0.5 the map looks thin.
mapping_completeness.title: Mapping Completeness

market_eur.description: Yearly household spending pool for the category, euros.

market_per_business.description: Euros per year per business (one pseudo-business added).

score.description: Market per business relative to the region; 1.0 = same as the region. None if too small.

thin_map.description: Mapping looks too thin to trust the supply estimate.
thin_map.title: Thin Map

visitor_eur.description: Foreign visitors' share of market_eur (Spanish visitors raise only the high end).

visitor_hotel_nights.description: Hotel nights in the last 12 months by origin (domestic, foreign).
visitor_hotel_nights.title: Visitor Hotel Nights

data_period.title: Data Period

dataset_id.description: Upstream identifier, e.g. INE table id '29005'.
dataset_id.title: Dataset Id

publisher.title: Publisher

retrieved_at.description: When this server fetched the data from upstream (UTC).
retrieved_at.title: Retrieved At

url.description: URL a person can open to see the data.

confidence.title: Confidence
